recommendations.title: Accelerate Compressor Station B restoration
recommendations.explanation: Gross production averaged 96,800 bopd, 19.3% below the 120,000 bopd plan, primarily because Compressor Station B operated at reduced capacity.
recommendations.impact: Approximately 23,200 bopd of deferred production while the constraint persists.

recommendations.title: Approve urgent export-line integrity expenditure
recommendations.explanation: The Ughelli inspection programme is seven days behind plan and has an immediate USD 3.2m commitment.
recommendations.impact: Reduces the risk of a longer evacuation constraint and unplanned outage.

recommendations.title: Resolve community access claim before 5 August
recommendations.explanation: The claim may restrict inspection access for the export-line programme.
recommendations.impact: Potential USD 6.2m exposure and further schedule delay.

recommendations.title: Protect liquidity ahead of September repayment
recommendations.explanation: Available liquidity is USD 42.5m with a USD 15m repayment due on 30 September; the downside case approaches minimum operating liquidity in Q4.
recommendations.impact: Preserves operating runway and reduces refinancing pressure.
